strings.A browser extension for Firefox and Chro: Firefox 與 Chromium 系瀏覽器的擴充功能，透過過濾清單封鎖廣告、追蹤器、惡意網站等內容。
strings.Block ads, trackers, coin miners, popups: 封鎖廣告、追蹤器、挖礦程式與彈出視窗
strings.Block content in Thunderbird feeds: 封鎖 Thunderbird 訂閱中的內容
strings.Load hosts files as blocklists: 載入 hosts 檔案作為封鎖清單
strings.Pick page elements to block: 點選頁面元素加以封鎖
strings.Simple popup interface for basic mode: 基本模式的簡易彈出介面
strings.block ads and trackers in the web browse: 在瀏覽器中封鎖廣告與追蹤器
strings.block ads, trackers, popups and malware: 封鎖廣告、追蹤器、彈出視窗與惡意網站
strings.block requests per site with a point-and: 以點選式防火牆依網站封鎖請求
strings.use EasyList and other filter lists: 使用 EasyList 等過濾清單
strings.write custom rules with extended filter: 以延伸過濾語法撰寫自訂規則
